name: Files changed opens in Smart Diff order, lock file last and collapsed
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the reviewer-ordered view: Core logic first, Boilerplate last, the seeded package-lock.json grouped as boilerplate and collapsed (its diff body is not rendered), and the seeded review's finding badge present on the file it flagged. Toggling to Original order falls back to the flat viewer. Read-only seeded data — Smart Diff is deterministic and makes no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
